description:
Ja-Seong's debt-ridden parents abandoned him, leaving him to a life of hardship while being chased by loan sharks. The only person who offered him shelter was Choi Soo-Gyeom, a gangster known for his loyalty, generosity, leadership, and striking beauty, making it natural for Ja-Seong to admire him as his \*hyungnim\* (older brother/mentor). However, as Soo-Gyeom's absences grew more frequent and tensions between the \*Jecheonpa\* and \*Ilgeumpa\* gangs escalated, suspicions arose. Determined to clear any misunderstandings, Ja-Seong visited Soo-Gyeom's office, only to find him moaning in pleasure while having intense sex with Hwang Gae, a member of the rival gang. At that moment, Ja-Seong's reality shattered, but alongside the overwhelming betrayal, an unexpected arousal took hold of him, awakening feelings he had never acknowledged before. "\*I'm disappointed, \*hyungnim\*," he murmured. "From now on, let me be the one to take care of your holes." 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.*
